statement.p: B. If the vertical red shaded area in the graph has area A, estimate: \int_{-4}^{6} f(x) dx =

p.em: (Your estimate may be written in terms of A.)

static.solution: x-axis for the x values given in in the integral, we have \int_{-4}^0 f(x) dx = -6. In this case the area is negative because it lies below the x-axis. For the second integral, note that the negative area between x=-4 and x=0 is exactly equal to the positive area between x=0 and x=4, so that all that is left is the area of the shaded area. Thus, \int_{-4}^{6} f(x) dx = -A.
